name: Familial Platelet Disorder with Propensity to Myeloid Malignancy

criteria.description: Presence of autosomal dominant family history of thrombocytopenia and/or myeloid malignancy
Identification of pathogenic germline RUNX1 mutation
Chronic mild to moderate thrombocytopenia with normal platelet size or mild macrothrombocytopenia
Bone marrow showing dysmegakaryopoiesis or myelodysplastic features without overt leukemia
Exclusion of other acquired or inherited causes of thrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pathogenic germline RUNX1 mutation plus family history of thrombocytopenia or myeloid malignancy and persistent thrombocytopenia
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for RUNX1 mutations is critical for diagnosis. Bone marrow evaluation supports but is not definitive.

pathognomonic.notes: Typically lifelong and present from childhood or early adulthood
searchTerms: chronic mild to moderate low platelets

pathognomonic.notes: Often includes acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome

common.notes: May be related to cytopenias or early marrow dysfunction
Occasional neutropenia or marrow dysfunction may contribute

occasional.notes: Nosebleeds related to low platelet counts
Bleeding from gums or other mucous membranes
Detected on marrow biopsy prior to malignancy
Slightly enlarged platelets on peripheral smear

rare.notes: Occurs in a subset of affected individuals
Occasionally present due to extramedullary hematopoiesis

laboratory: Persistent thrombocytopenia with normal or slightly enlarged platelets
Bone marrow dysmegakaryopoiesis and myelodysplastic features
Normal to mildly decreased white blood cell counts
imaging: Occasional splenomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT
other: Family history of thrombocytopenia and myeloid malignancies

distinguishingFeatures: No family history of myeloid malignancy

redFlags: Development of blasts in peripheral blood
Family history of early-onset acute myeloid leukemia
references: Song WJ, et al. Haploinsufficiency of RUNX1 causes familial thrombocytopenia with predisposition to acute myelogenous leukemia. Nat Genet. 1999.
Owen CJ, et al. Familial platelet disorder with RUNX1 mutation: clinical and laboratory features. Br J Haematol. 2016.
Arber DA, et al. The 2016 revision to the WHO classification of myeloid neoplasms and acute leukemia. Blood. 2016.
